en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakkuny, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who bequeaths with a third of his wealth, then kills by mistake, so the third included his blood money (compensation) in his bequest’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘If one makes a will about one-third of his legacy, then is killed by mistake, one-third of the wergild for him becomes part of that which he has willed.’”
